CustomField.description: Written by the `FQS_Auto_Name_Gift_Transaction` flow on insert and on relevant updates. Skipped when `FQS_Skip_Naming__c = TRUE`.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically by the FQS naming flow. Format: donor + amount + date + gift kind. To keep a specific Name from being overwritten — e.g., a name imported from another system — check *Skip Naming*.
